items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Like Noah, all that, and like the higher society kind of part.

ctx.x: Well he had a funny attack sometimes. But then other times he could play very clean. His brakes were extremely clean. Yeah, yeah.
He had execution. Like Noah, all that, and like the higher society kind of part. He played all of that with his trombone.
But if he wanted to, he'd get a sort of a slap attack. When he wanted to, that's the thing. And it was funny. I thought he was funny at times.
